AOC 24B36X 23.8 Inch FHD IPS 144Hz Gaming Monitor

Experience fluid gameplay and exceptional color depth with the AOC 24B36X 23.8 Inch gaming monitor, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Built with a vibrant Full HD 1920x1080 IPS panel, this display delivers highly accurate visuals paired with wide 178-degree viewing angles. Perfect for fast-paced competitive setups, it features a smooth 144Hz refresh rate and a rapid 0.5ms MPRT response time to effectively eliminate motion blur and input lag. With a strong 1500:1 static contrast ratio, 300 nits of brightness, and HDR10 compliance, it produces deeper shadows and brighter highlights for immersive media and gaming. Its clean profile integrates flawlessly into modern desktop workspaces. This reliable gaming upgrade comes backed by a comprehensive 1-year warranty structure.
